canonical_name: particles 0.4 -- sequential Monte Carlo / particle filtering in Python (Nicolas Chopin)
lineage: Particle filtering (Gordon, Salmond, Smith 1993 bootstrap filter; Doucet et al.) as the companion code to Chopin & Papaspiliopoulos, An Introduction to Sequential Monte Carlo (2020): state-space models, resampling schemes (multinomial, residual, stratified, systematic), SMC samplers, particle MCMC.
entry_points: particles.SMC(fk=Bootstrap(ssm, data), N, resampling); state_space_models.StateSpaceModel; resampling.*

example.command: python harness: simulate a linear-Gaussian model, run the bootstrap filter, compare filtering means to the Kalman filter
example.input: T observations from a known model
example.output: particle filter mean within tolerance of the exact Kalman mean (the ORACLE)

upstream_docs: Chopin & Papaspiliopoulos, An Introduction to Sequential Monte Carlo, Springer 2020
Gordon, Salmond, Smith, Novel approach to nonlinear/non-Gaussian Bayesian state estimation, IEE Proc F 1993

human_capability_summary.built_to: track a hidden state through nonlinear, non-Gaussian dynamics by propagating and reweighting a cloud of hypotheses
human_capability_summary.pressure: hidden state, noisy observations, models where the Kalman filter's Gaussian assumption fails; weight degeneracy fought by resampling
human_capability_summary.success_means: the weighted cloud's mean tracks the true posterior mean; on the linear-Gaussian case it matches the Kalman filter to Monte-Carlo error

human_environmental_pressure: hidden state, observation noise, nonlinearity, particle degeneracy
human_failure_condition: weight degeneracy: one particle carries all the weight and the estimate collapses
behavioral_entry_point: reduce N or switch resampling off (resampling=None) and watch the ESS collapse; change the observation noise

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run particles-chopin-0.4
nyx_handoff.what_humans_used_it_for: track a hidden state through nonlinear, non-Gaussian dynamics by propagating and reweighting a cloud of hypotheses
